question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Maintanence** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**maintenance**". • The mistake is in the placement of the "**e**" and "**a**" in the word. • The correct pronunciation is "main-tuh-nuhns". • **Maintenance **means the act of maintaining or keeping something in good condition. • **Example**: *The maintenance team regularly checks and repairs the building's electrical systems to ensure they function properly.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Infer **means to deduce or conclude something from evidence or reasoning. (साक्ष्य या तर्क से कुछ निष्कर्ष निकालना) • **Neutral **means not taking sides or being impartial. (किसी का पक्ष न लेना या निष्पक्ष न होना) • **Apprehensive **means anxious or fearful about something that might happen. (किसी घटना के बारे में चिंतित या भयभीत होना) 3c:T612, The correct answer is: **By virtue off**
